warnings: *** NO TREAD OR RISER DIMENSION IS GIVEN ON THIS SHEET. *** Every step dimension is replaced by the note 'ระยะลูกนอนตามแบบสถาปัตยกรรม' / 'ระยะลูกตั้งตามแบบสถาปัตยกรรม' -- go to the architectural drawings (A-01..A-31) for them. tread_m and riser_m are therefore null with the deferral recorded verbatim, not guessed at. The same applies to one bar tag, 'Ø9 มม.@ตามแบบ', whose spacing is set out to match the step layout.

ST-1 IS DRAWN AS TWO SEPARATE FLIGHT DETAILS but only the lower one carries the title 'ขยายบันได ST-1'. The upper detail at the top of the sheet is the same stair's other flight -- both share the 0.15 waist, the same bar set, the B6 landing beam and the 1.00 m lap. They are recorded as two section_views of one ST-1 element rather than as two stairs.

THE TWO STAIRS ARE REINFORCED QUITE DIFFERENTLY: ST-1 uses Ø12@0.20 main bars (tightening to Ø12@0.10 across the landing) on a 0.15 waist; ST2 uses only Ø9@0.20 on a 0.10 waist. Do not carry ST-1's bar schedule across to ST2.
Landing support differs too: ST-1 lands on the RC beam B6 ('B6,คานชานพัก'), ST2 spans between two B2X beams. Both beam marks are defined on S-12.

'1Ø9 มม.ทุกมุม' -- one Ø9 bar at EVERY step corner -- appears on both stairs. The number of corners is not stated, so no total count can be derived from this sheet alone; it depends on the step count in the architectural drawings.

The sheet's own title block says 'ขยายบันได ST-1, ST-2' with a hyphen, while the drawing titles read 'ขยายบันได ST-1' and 'ขยายบันได ST2' (no hyphen on the second). The plans on S-03/S-04 also use ST1 and ST2 without hyphens. Recorded as printed in each place; they are the same two stairs.

RESOLVED BY A-16 (PNG 18). The architectural stair enlargement gives what this sheet deferred: ST-1 has 10 ลูกตั้ง @0.15 and 9 ลูกนอน @0.275 per flight, two flights, 20 risers, 3.00 m total rise, 0.90 m flight width in a 2.40 m well, 1.30 m landing. ST-2 is on A-18.
